==Standard dialogue==
* '''Gunnjorn:''' Haha welcome to my obstacle course. Have fun, but remember this isn't a child's playground. People have died here.
* '''Gunnjorn:''' The best way to train, is to go round the course in a clockwise direction.
* {{tact|end}}

==Treasure Trails==
===Hard===
* {{tact|receives=a puzzle box}}
* '''Gunnjorn:''' Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
* Gunnjorn has given you a puzzle box!
* {{tact|end}}
====While holding the puzzle box====
* {{tcond|If the puzzle is not solved:}}
** '''Gunnjorn:''' Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the puzzle is not in the inventory but the clue is:}}
** '''Player:''' I don't have the puzzle box with me.
** '''Gunnjorn:''' That's not much use is it, go and fetch it!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the puzzle is solved and in the inventory:}}
** '''Gunnjorn:''' Thanks [player name]!
** {{tcond|When given another clue scroll:}}
*** {{tbox|pic=Clue scroll (hard) detail.png|Gunnjorn has given you another clue scroll!}}
*** {{tact|receives=a [[clue scroll (hard)]]}}
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|When given a reward casket:}}
*** {{tbox|pic=Reward casket (hard) detail.png|You've obtained a casket!}}
*** {{tact|receives=a [[reward casket (hard)]]}}
*** {{tact|end}}
